draft.inside_message: Congratulations on Telemachus, which I now believe in rather more than I did this morning. This card was drafted, printed and posted by the thing I built on my trial day, so if the envelope arrived, it works. Thank you for the day.
draft.sign_off: With thanks and a bit of glee,

artwork_brief.style_note: small bright sparks, generous white space, unfussy

flags: The card refers to itself being drafted and posted by the product, which is the point of the occasion but reads as self-referential; confirm that is intended.
draft.rationale: Leans on the trial day and Telemachus itself as the proof, with light self-deprecating humour in Akshay's own voice.
